get.description:
One level of the library as folders and files, like a column in a file browser.

Without ``root_id`` the libraries are the folders. With one, the folders and files directly inside
``path``. Every folder carries how many files below it are in each state; ``state`` keeps only
the files in that state, and the folders that still hold any. ``hide`` drops the files in any of
the comma-separated states.
Every file below a folder, whatever the depth, so an action on a folder can reach its files.

The gate and, as separate signals, whether a scheduler and a media worker hold their leases.

A running API says nothing about the workers: they are reported on their own.
The configured libraries by name, each with its latest scan; the filesystem path stays private.
